quote.text: Forsan et haec olim meminisse iuvabit.
quote.english: Perhaps one day it will be a pleasure to remember even this.

poem.text:
身にしむや
亡妻の櫛を
閨に踏む
poem.english:
a chill through me —
in the bedroom, underfoot,
my dead wife's comb
poem.note: His wife outlived him by many years; the grief is imagined, which is the point of the comb. He was a painter too, and it is a painter's poem: one object, the whole house around it.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version

painting.title: The Ten Largest, No. 7, Adulthood
painting.note: Painted in 1907, years before abstraction was credited to anyone else. She left instructions that the work not be shown until twenty years after her death, and it was not shown properly for forty.

song.title: Spiegel im Spiegel
song.note: Mirror in the mirror: a piano triad and a violin line that never hurries, written just before he left Estonia.
